scripts.build: npm run build:engine && npm run build:languages && npm run build:packages && npm run build:ui
scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler dev -c wrangler.jsonc -c engine/wrangler.jsonc -c engine/wrangler-python.jsonc -c engine/wrangler-perl.jsonc -c engine/wrangler-ruby.jsonc
scripts.pack: npm run build && npm pack -w @sandbox-workers/core -w @sandbox-workers/javascript -w @sandbox-workers/python -w @sandbox-workers/perl -w @sandbox-workers/ruby --pack-destination dist
scripts.build:languages: node scripts/fetch-languages.mjs && node scripts/meter-languages.mjs python perl ruby
scripts.deploy:engines: npm run deploy:engine && wrangler deploy -c engine/wrangler-python.jsonc && wrangler deploy -c engine/wrangler-perl.jsonc && wrangler deploy -c engine/wrangler-ruby.jsonc
